text:
Nina: Procurement narrowed to BillMap vs ClearRecon for automating invoice ingest + reconciliation. Need quick clarifications on CSV schema, incremental imports, SSO/SCIM, and pricing so we can scope a 2-week pilot.

Omar: I demoed BillMap last month. They had a very flexible mapping UI but their backfill tooling required a dedicated worker which we might need to run in our VPC.

Jules: ClearRecon promised a managed backfill and single CSV format. Curious about how they handle nested line-items and credit memos.

Finance-bot: FYI: Any vendor commit >$7k/yr needs director approval. Include expected first-year run-rate.

procurement: @vendor-claire can you confirm ClearRecon's CSV schema and whether you accept gzipped files for bulk imports? Also SAML + SCIM?

vendor-claire: Hi all — ClearRecon accepts gzipped CSV/NDJSON via POST /api/v1/imports. Schema: invoice_id, account_id, invoice_date, due_date, currency, total_amount, tax_amount, line_items_json. We support SAML SSO and SCIM (users only, groups coming Q3). Sample file: https://downloads.clearrecon.example/samples/sample_invoices.csv.gz

Nina: Good. Do you provide a dedupe_key or dedupe by invoice_id? Our pipeline uses external_id as source of truth.
vendor-claire: We dedupe by (source_system, external_id) when provided; invoice_id is your internal id. You can provide external_id in mapping.

Omar: Pricing? Need cost for expected 500k invoices/year and any connectors or region fees.

vendor-claire: Pricing: $0.035/invoice at scale with volume breaks (negotiable at >1M), plus $1,200/mo base for enterprise features (BYOK, dedicated ingestion). EU data residency + KMS is an additional $300/mo. One-time onboarding $1,500.

Jules: BillMap offered a lower per-invoice fee but charged for connector work and had a higher onboarding charge last time.

procurement: @Nina can you share BillMap quote so we compare apples-to-apples? Also confirm BillMap's SLA for reconciliation lookup latency (we need sub-200ms p95).

Nina: BillMap quote: $0.012/invoice up to 1M, $600/mo platform fee, onboarding $3k, connectors $250/connector/mo for non-standard connectors. SLA for lookup was p95 180ms on demo.

Infra: We need to confirm whether either vendor will require outbound access from our internal networks. BillMap mentioned an agent. Any details?

vendor-claire: ClearRecon offers both managed cloud ingest and a customer-run agent for air-gapped or restricted networks. The agent posts to our ingestion queue over mutual TLS; we publish image + checksum.

procurement: Legal, any mandatory clauses? Data return, DPA, and deletion timelines?

Legal: Require DPA, 30-day data return or deletion, and audit rights. BYOK/KMS support is preferred. If BillMap agent stores raw PII locally, we need a signed attestation and retention limits.

Jules: Operational question: how do they surface reconciled vs unreconciled items in their API? Need a single endpoint to query status for a given external_id.

vendor-claire: We expose GET /api/v1/invoices?external_id=<id> with status field (reconciled|unreconciled|review) and events array. We also have webhook notifications on status changes.

Nina: Can you share a sample curl for bulk import so Eng can smoke test?

vendor-claire: Sure:

curl -X POST https://api.clearrecon.example/api/v1/imports
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
  -F "file=@sample_invoices.csv.gz"
  -F "mapping=external_id,account_id,invoice_date,total_amount,line_items_json"

Finance-bot: Reminder: Keep pilot spend under $2k if possible to avoid PO.

procurement: Proposed plan: 2-week side-by-side pilot with scripted dataset (10k invoices including duplicates and credits). Evaluate: ingest error rate, dedupe accuracy, API latency (p95), integration hours, and TCO year1-3. Owners: Nina -> BillMap POC, Jules -> ClearRecon POC, Omar -> perf tests.

Infra: We'll provide sandbox VPC and test credentials. If vendor agent needed, we'll coordinate security review.

vendor-claire: We'll provision a sandbox tenant and share credentials today. We're happy to enable group webhook callbacks for faster testing.

Nina: I'll collect BillMap quote and post a comparison spreadsheet. If both pilots look okay, Legal will start SOW/DPA redlines.

Legal: I'll prep a baseline DPA + BYOK checklist and add it to the vendor scorecard.

procurement: Thanks everyone. Re-check in two weeks with POC results. :thumbsup:

Jules: Starting ClearRecon setup now.

Omar: Perf test harnessing begins tomorrow.

Nina: Copy, will post status updates to this thread.
